name: @lglen/exa-cli
stderr:
Usage: exa [options] [command]

Web search, page fetching, and deep research via the Exa MCP server and API.

Options:
  -V, --version                      output the version number
  -h, --help                         display help for command

Commands:
  search [options] <query>           Search the web for a topic and return clean
                                     result content (MCP web_search_exa).
  fetch [options] <urls...>          Fetch full clean markdown content from one
                                     or more URLs (MCP web_fetch_exa).
  advanced-search [options] <query>  Web search with full control over filters,
                                     categories, and result content.
  deep-search [options] <query>      Deep research via the Exa API (requires an
                                     Exa API key; not available over MCP).
  agent                              Run and manage Exa Agent tasks (requires an
                                     Exa API key).
  auth [api-key]                     Save or inspect the Exa API key used by the
                                     CLI.
  tools [options]                    List the tools and schemas exposed by the
                                     Exa MCP server.
  help [command]                     display help for command

Examples:
  $ exa search "how pi extensions register tools" -n 5
  $ exa fetch https://example.com https://arxiv.org/abs/2401.00001 --max-characters 5000
  $ exa advanced-search "vector database benchmarks" --category news --highlights
  $ exa deep-search "state of open-source MCP servers" --type deep-reasoning
  $ exa agent run "Find the three largest MCP server projects" --effort medium
  $ exa auth
  $ exa tools

Run `exa <command> --help` for command-specific options and examples.
Auth: run `exa auth` to save a key, or set EXA_API_KEY. The MCP-backed
search/fetch/advanced-search commands also work without a key on the free tier.
